archiveTitle: 日报｜Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold延期至2月23日

decisions.headline: 《Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold》延期至2027年2月23日，2月19日开启抢先体验
decisions.summary: 史克威尔艾尼克斯在东京Fan Fest公布，《最终幻想14》8.0资料片Evercold由原定2027年1月窗口延期至2月23日，抢先体验从2月19日开始；预购将于11月4日开放。两家独立媒体报道一致，日期与预购信息均来自现场发布内容。

decisions.reason: 人工二次发布仅删除重复主体前缀；保留同一事件、原事实框架、来源、日期和全部既有事实。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Delayed

entries.headline: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold delayed to February 23, 2027, with early access on February 19
entries.summary: Square Enix announced at the Tokyo Fan Festival that Final Fantasy XIV's 8.0 expansion Evercold has moved from its January 2027 window to February 23, with early access beginning February 19. Preorders open November 4.
entries.verification: IGN and Gematsu independently reported the same dates from the Fan Festival announcement; no unverified hour-level timing is stated.
entries.timeNote: Full launch: February 23, 2027; early access: February 19; preorders open November 4, 2026.
